input.hidden_states: Tensor [s, b, h] — already contains x + residual from previous bias_dropout_add

output.normalized_output: Tensor [s, b, h] — RMSNorm(hidden_states, weight, eps)
output.residual: Tensor [s, b, h] — identical to input hidden_states (forked by MakeExtraOutput)

FORWARD_SEMANTICS.critical_note: The add (x + residual) is NOT fused into this kernel. It happens in the PREVIOUS layer output projection via bias_dropout_add. This kernel only does RMSNorm + residual pass-through.
FORWARD_SEMANTICS.mathematical_form: y = (x + r) / rms(x + r) * w,  output=(y, x+r)  where r is residual from previous layer. The +r part is done by the previous bias_dropout_add.

gradients.dx: Gradient through RMSNorm: dL/dx from dL/dy via RMSNorm backward. The residual fork also receives gradient from the bias_dropout_add path.
gradients.dweight: Gradient w.r.t. RMSNorm weight: dL/dw = sum(dL/dy * x / rms)
gradients.dresidual: The residual output gradient comes from the bias_dropout_add backward, NOT from the norm backward. The residual fork creates two gradient paths that sum.

saved_activations: x (input) or rstd (1/rms) — needed for backward to compute dx and dw
forward output y — needed if dropout follows
BACKWARD_SEMANTICS.recomputation: input_layernorm can be recomputed (config.recompute_modules includes layernorm). When recomputed, saved activations from norm forward are discarded and re-derived during backward.

DTYPES.weight: FP32 (TE maintains weight in FP32, casts at kernel boundary)
DTYPES.fp8_support: TE supports FP8 for norm weight; Megatron v0.19.1 has FP8 integration via fp8_meta

REALISTIC_SHAPES.source: Megatron-LM transformer_config.py and community model configs
REALISTIC_SHAPES.tensor_parallel_effect: hidden_size is divided by TP size. TP=1,2,4,8 common. RMSNorm operates on local hidden_size after TP split.
REALISTIC_SHAPES.sequence_parallel_effect: seq_len is divided by SP size. Each rank processes seq_len/SP tokens. RMSNorm is local to each rank.
REALISTIC_SHAPES.note: Standalone 56-shape suite can be retained as microbenchmark supplement, but campaign MUST include Megatron-realistic shapes.

tensor_parallel.effect_on_norm: RMSNorm weight is a local [h/TP] parameter. No communication needed for norm itself.
tensor_parallel.effect_on_residual: Residual tensor is local [s, b, h/TP]. No communication.
tensor_parallel.communication: None within RMSNorm. Communication happens in adjacent linear layers (all-reduce for row-parallel, identity for column-parallel).

sequence_parallel.effect_on_norm: Each rank computes RMSNorm on its sequence shard [s/SP, b, h]. Local operation.
sequence_parallel.communication: None within RMSNorm. all-gather / reduce-scatter happen in adjacent ops.

pipeline_parallel.effect: None. RMSNorm is a per-layer operation.

PARALLELISM_CONTEXT.fusion_opportunity: RMSNorm could be fused with residual-add from previous layer, but current Megatron architecture separates them (bias_dropout_add in output projection + RMSNorm in next layer input).

BASELINE_IMPLEMENTATION.name: Transformer Engine RMSNorm
BASELINE_IMPLEMENTATION.backend: TE CUDA kernels (fused RMSNorm with optional MakeExtraOutput)
BASELINE_IMPLEMENTATION.forward: RMSNorm(x, weight, eps) → y  OR  (y, residual)
BASELINE_IMPLEMENTATION.backward: TE autograd: dx, dw gradients through fused CUDA kernels

residual.tolerance: rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-7 (should be bit-identical to input x+r)

CORRECTNESS_CONTRACT.test_coverage: All 56 standalone shapes + Megatron-realistic shapes. Per-shape max_abs, max_rel, pass/fail.

PERFORMANCE_CONTRACT.note: Training-op benchmark must include backward, not just forward

direct_reuse: profiler integration (NCU adapter, one-shape worker, ProcessRegistry)
needs_adapter: Build integration (JIT compile or prebuilt extension)
Campaign config (new campaign directory + episode scaffolding)

BLOCKERS.blocker: No existing fused ResidualAdd+RMSNorm kernel in Megatron-LM
BLOCKERS.detail: Current Megatron architecture separates residual-add (bias_dropout_add) from RMSNorm. A true fused kernel does not exist yet.
BLOCKERS.resolution: Campaign must create a NEW candidate kernel implementing y=RMSNorm(x+residual, weight, eps)

BLOCKERS.blocker: Megatron-realistic shapes need to be extracted from configs
BLOCKERS.resolution: Manually define shape set based on Megatron transformer_config.py and known model configs
